tweetText: HP Inc. expands its partnership with OpenAI to enhance AI in customer experiences, software development, and operations. This move signals a significant step in integrating AI to boost efficiency and innovation. via OpenAI News

Ford is bringing back experienced engineers after realizing AI alone isn't enough to ensure high-quality results. This move highlights the importance of human expertise in tech development. via TechCrunch AI

Wall Street is betting on Micron, seeing it as the next Nvidia due to its potential in the booming AI sector. This could signal a shift in investment towards memory makers as crucial players in AI technology. via TechCrunch AI

A new humanoid robot from Flexion Robotics, created by ex-Nvidia engineers, is impressively skilled at office tasks. This innovation could change how we think about automation in the workplace. via WIRED AI
China's Z.ai claims its GLM-5.2 model can match Mythos in cybersecurity tasks. This raises concerns for the US, as it shows China's rapid advancements in AI capabilities. via The Verge AI.

Suno launched the Spark incubator program to support independent artists with grants, mentorship, and marketing. This matters because it aims to foster new talent while raising questions about artists' rights over their music. via The Verge AI
